title: Mansu Hill Grand Monument

centralIdentity.name: Monument of the Great Comrades Kim Il-sung and Kim Jong-il

limitations: The bronze portraits and flanking relief figures are modeled from photographs. Individual figures, stone folds and the mountain mosaic are stylized reconstructions.
PMTiles fixes the statue points, museum plan and flanking lawns. The exterior stair and finished floor elevations are estimated from the photographs and standard Terrarium grade.
